lines.text: Most setups make the agent check for news over and over. Is there a reply yet?
Every check costs time and tokens, and most of them come back empty.
Slow the timer down to save effort, and you answer in seconds but wait a minute for the agent.
Speed the timer up, and the agent spends its day asking, instead of doing the work you gave it.
The better idea is to flip it around, so the agent stops asking and gets told instead.
Agent R Q pushes updates the moment they happen, so there is nothing for the agent to check.
They travel over a live stream that stays open for the whole session, between you and the agent.
The stream feeds straight into Claude Code's own notification channel, so it feels like a built in feature.
You answer a question, and the agent hears it instantly, within the same second.
There is no waiting for the next check, because there is no next check to wait for.
Replies, approvals, and new tasks all arrive the same way, live, the moment they exist.
How long does your agent sit waiting on you? Be honest, tell us in the comments, and try Agent R Q dot com.
